data.name: Codename: Rogue Fleet
data.detailed_description:
Nova atualização

Version 2.0 of Codename: Rogue Fleet come with completely revamped ships, new intuitive controls with keybinding profiles and more.


Acerca do jogo

Codename: Rogue Fleet is a multiplayer team-based game about spaceships combat. You can choose to play as huge capital ships, tiny fighters or anything in between. A match as a fighter pilot is packed with action as you leave the thinking to the player who choose bigger ships.

A match of Rogue Fleet will pit two team of 12 players against each other. At the start of a match, players will choose their ship and with the help of their team, by managing the strengths and weaknesses of their respective ships, players will achieve victory by destroying all enemy ships.

Features

  • Destructible turrets, missile launchers and ship's sub-systems.
  • 10 ships to choose from, with various strengths and weaknesses , split between 5 classes.
  • Radically different gameplay when playing capital ship as opposed to fighters.

reviews.review:
so a lot of revies pointing out the bad things about the game like its supposed to be AAA 60 buck release.

i tested it for a like two hours my self.
500mb download so no time wasted there.

this game is [u]FREE TO PLAY with NO microtransactions[/u] .... it is really completly free.
i don't know how many people are woking on this game but i wouldn't be suprised if its only one person doing his/hers first steps into game dev.

so giving that he/she publishes the game what costs as far as i know 100$ on steam and then asking for nothing more then feedback in return is something i can relly respect.

[list]
[*]yes the game has no chat 
[*]yes the lock on missiles lack bit of friend foe detection
[*]yes the controls are a bit wierd and hard to understand if you are not used to other games that use it -----> EDIT 24.01.16: a recent update changed the controls according to player feedback and they are intuitive now.
[/list]

[u]BUT its still a basic framework of a game[/u]

no statisic tracking -----> wich in my opinion is somewhat refreshing , in many other games the stat padding alters the playstyle of the players to much.

and to the bombers and interceptors 
-they are very easy to fly (good for beginners as long as you don't expect W makes you go forward, i was sitting next to a bomber player not figuring out that [u]SPACE[/u] activates your main engine before he left)
-then to the point ppl say they are OP ... well the have advantages and someone in a bigger ship with not really any expirience can get really upset about them but i had no problem taking fighter/bombers out with the homing missiles (just throw enough missiles at them and the 5 missiles needed to kill them gonna hit after a while)



[b]THIS GAME IS 100% FREE AND FOR THAT FACT ITS GOOD ENOUGH[/b]

so dear DEV keep going keep working on it, you are on the right road.
